title: Fade Project (fade.json)
description: Project manifest for a Fade Playground workspace. Replaces csproj inside the Playground. The file is required at the root of every project folder and may be edited, but cannot be deleted or renamed by the UI.

description.description: Optional free-text project description shown in the workspace picker.

type.description: Project flavor. 'web' runs in the WebRuntime worker (console-style commands). 'monogame' runs in the WebRuntime.MonoGame canvas runtime (KNI-backed graphics).

commandDlls.description: Command assemblies to load into the runtime. Each entry names an assembly and the specific class within it to instantiate. Mirrors the <FadeCommand Include='...' FullName='...' /> MSBuild item.

class.description: Fully-qualified class name within the assembly, e.g. 'FadeBasic.Lib.Web.WebCommands'.

sources.description: Ordered list of .fbasic source files belonging to this project. ORDER MATTERS — sources are concatenated in this order before compilation, matching the native Fade SDK build path. Each entry is a workspace-relative filename.

sweepInterval.description: Heap allocations between garbage collections. Higher = fewer collections but more memory use. 0 (or omitted) keeps the VM default of 64. Raise it (or set a very large value) to effectively disable collection for a short session.

paranoid.description: Diagnostic mode: poison freed heap memory with a sentinel and never reuse it, so a use-after-free (a live object the GC wrongly reclaimed) surfaces immediately as a crash/garbage instead of silent corruption. Uses more memory; intended for hunting GC bugs, not shipping.
